entries.claim: Sum of k from k=1 to n equals one half n(n+1).

entries.claim: Sum of k squared from k=1 to n equals one sixth n(n+1)(2n+1).

entries.claim: A constant factor can be taken out of the sum. Printed example: sum of 5k equals 5 times sum of k.

entries.claim: The sum of a sum is the sum of the sums. Printed example given.
entries.quote: Example: (k²+4) = Σ k² + Σ 4

entries.claim: The sum of a difference is the difference of the sums. Printed example given.
entries.quote: Example: (2k−3) = 2 Σ k − Σ 3

entries.claim: Formula for the sum of cubes: the sum of k^3 for k from 1 to n equals the square of one half n(n+1).

entries.claim: When r>1 the sum of the first n terms equals a(r^n-1)/(r-1).
